quote: If another man succeed by one effort, he will use a hundred efforts... though weak, he will surely become strong.
meaning: If others need one try, you do a hundred. Weak today, strong later.

who: Marie Curie · Letter to her brother, 1894
quote: Life is not easy for any of us. But what of that? We must have perseverance and above all confidence in ourselves.
meaning: She was a poor student in Paris. She won two Nobel Prizes. Keep going, and believe in yourself.

quote: No tree which the wind does not often blow against is firm and strong...
meaning: A tree in the wind grows deep roots. Hard times make you strong.

who: Srinivasa Ramanujan · Letter to G. H. Hardy, 1913
quote: I have had no University education but I have undergone the ordinary school course.
meaning: A poor office clerk who loved maths. In 1918 he joined the Royal Society, one of the top honours in science.

quote: Drop by drop is the water pot filled.
meaning: One drop is small. Many drops fill the pot. A little practice every day adds up.

quote: I will seize Fate by the throat; it shall certainly not crush me completely.
meaning: He was going deaf. He kept writing music. Deaf, he finished his famous Ninth Symphony in 1824.

quote: Say not, 'Tis hard', in weak, desponding hour, for strenuous effort gives prevailing power.
meaning: On a weak day, don't say "too hard." Keep working. Hard work makes you strong.

who: Tenzing Norgay · Tiger of the Snows, 1955
quote: It has been a long road. From... a bearer of loads, to a wearer of a coat with rows of medals...
meaning: He began by carrying loads for climbers. In 1953 he stood on top of Everest.

quote: Your pain is the breaking of the shell that encloses your understanding.
meaning: Pain is a shell breaking. Something new is growing inside you.

quote: The triumph can't be had without the struggle.
meaning: As a child she wore a leg brace. In 1960 she won three Olympic gold medals.

who: Miyamoto Musashi · The Book of Five Rings, 1645
quote: After that I studied morning and evening searching for the principle, and came to realize the Way of strategy when I was fifty.
meaning: He trained morning and evening. He understood his art at fifty. It is never too late.

quote: However difficult life may seem, there is always something you can do and succeed at.
meaning: At 21, an illness began to stop his body. He became one of the great scientists of his time.
